data.name: Abaas
data.gender_notes: Abaas is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Abaas is a name of Arabic origin which means 'Father of a lion'. It is a significant name in Islamic history, as Abaas ibn Abdul Muttalib was the uncle of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He played a crucial role in raising and protecting the Prophet during his early life. The name Abaas carries the meaning “Father of a lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abaas usually hope their child will grow to embody father of a lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength, courage, and protection for one's family.
data.etymology: Abaas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of a lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abaas total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عباس
in_arabic.meaning: أبيض الوجه، أسمر اللون، شديد السواد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مشتق من الجذر العربي (ع ب س) الذي يعني السواد الشديد أو الغامق. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية 144، ويعني الشخص الذي يكون وجهه أبيض وبشرته سوداء أو شديدة السواد. يعتبر اسم عباس من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية، وغالباً ما يوصف به الشخص الشديد أو القوي.

in_urdu.name: عباس
in_urdu.meaning: سختی کا تجربہ کرنے والا، دکھی کا شریک
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کے جذر (ع ب س) سے نکلا ہوا، جس کا مطلب ہے شدت یا سختی۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں اس نام کا بڑا احترام ہے کیونکہ حضرت عباس بن علی بن ابی طالب (ع) ایک مشہور شخصیت تھے جنہوں نے کربلا کی جنگ میں شہادت حاصل کی۔ یہ نام اکثر ایسے شخص کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دکھیوں کا شریک اور مشکلات کا متحمل ہو.

in_hindi.name: अब्बास

in_english.name: Abaas
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root (ع ب س), meaning intense darkness or sternness. Referenced in the Quran in Surah Al Imran verse 144. Historically significant in Islamic tradition as the name of Hz. Abbas, a courageous companion of Imam Ali. Symbolizes strength, resilience, and loyalty. Commonly used across Muslim cultures to signify someone with a strong and steadfast personality.
